summary: Adding title display and search to the Runbooks panel of an internal ops dashboard (React + Express), on a main that already has the alert rules editor and incidents pagination merged. Works alongside peer agents it can message.

history.content: The Runbooks panel only lists file names, from a list hard-coded in the panel. Show each runbook's title instead, and add a search box that filters them by title and text.
Let me look at the panel and the runbooks.

# Disk free on db hosts

1. Find the largest tables.
2. Vacuum, or ask infra for more disk.

Each runbook starts with a "# " heading, which makes a good title. The web app can't read these files itself, so the API will serve them. I'll check with platform-agent that the API has them at runtime.

args.message: The ops dashboard API will start reading runbooks/*.md to serve them to the Runbooks panel. Is the runbooks/ folder present in the API container at runtime?

history.content: platform-agent: Yes. The API image copies the whole repo except node_modules, so runbooks/ is at /app/runbooks, and the API runs from /app, so the relative path works. The web bundle has none of it. One thing to know: a nightly job publishes the runbooks to the wiki and uses each file's first `# ` heading as the page title, so keep that heading in every runbook.
Good: the API can read runbooks/ relative to where it runs, and the first heading is already what the wiki uses as the title.
